scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run check --workspace cloud
scripts.cloud:deploy:acceptance: npm run build --workspace web && aws-classify cloud deploy --config cloud/serverless.yml --stage acceptance --region us-east-1 --publish --source web/dist
scripts.cloud:publish:acceptance: npm run build --workspace web && aws-classify cloud publish --config cloud/serverless.yml --stage acceptance --region us-east-1 --source web/dist
scripts.cloud:remove:acceptance: aws-classify cloud remove --config cloud/serverless.yml --stage acceptance --region us-east-1
